title: manageLoop
responsibility: Creates, edits, completes, reads, and renders loop state and trace; completion can enforce regression and final-task audits.

inputs.name: createLoop.input
inputs.description: Loop name and goal plus optional root, creation-time provider, source template, agent model, completion kind, and plan.

inputs.name: addLoopStep.input
inputs.description: Loop id, new step id and title, with optional root and timestamp provider.

inputs.name: completeLoopStep.input
inputs.description: Loop id, pending step id, evidence text, and optional root/time provider.

inputs.name: readLoopStatus.input
inputs.description: Loop id and optional repository root.

inputs.name: renderLoopStatus.status
inputs.description: Loop state and relative trace path to display.

inputs.name: renderLoopStatus.now
inputs.description: Current timestamp for age display; defaults to the current ISO timestamp.

outputs.name: createLoop
outputs.description: New loop state and trace path after initializing template steps/evaluators and appending the creation event.

outputs.name: addLoopStep
outputs.description: Updated loop state and trace path after appending a pending step.

outputs.name: completeLoopStep
outputs.description: Updated loop state and trace path after recording completion time and evidence.

outputs.name: readLoopStatus
outputs.description: Current loop state and relative trace path.

outputs.name: renderLoopStatus
outputs.description: Human-readable loop identity, goal, trace path, activity, closure details, and step list.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Invalid loop id or missing/invalid persisted state.
